actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed >5 and was the highest contributor in the last round, so I apply the maximum affordable punishment and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow rules: check latest round contributions. Round 4 contributions: Resident2 12.5 (>5), Resident5 4.69, others 0. So highest >5 is Resident2. We must punish Resident2 with severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet=20, cost=0.3, max severity = floor(20/0.3)= floor(66.666)=66. So punish amount 66 severity. Action punish Resident2 amount 66. Also broadcast discouraging message. Ensure not exceed wallet cost: cost = severity * punishment_cost = 66*0.3 = 19.8, within wallet 20. After punishment wallet will reduce by 19.8 leaving 0.2.

Return actions list with punish and broadcast. Explanation brief.
